knobs.note: BH-6382: a merged perf PR is measured this many hours after GitHub's merged_at, on live data. Earlier ticks do not read it.
BH-6382: merge-ledger rows (kind merge) updated in the last this-many hours are candidates. Keep it above OUTCOME_CHECK_MAX_WAIT_H, or a PR that waits for samples ages out before it is decided.
BH-6382: a measurement with fewer samples than this is not decided. The PR gets a wait row and is measured again next tick.
BH-6382: this many hours after the merge, a PR that still has too few samples is recorded insufficient, with one ALERTS line.
BH-6382: at most this many due PRs are checked per tick, oldest first. The rest are logged as deferred and drain on later ticks. PRs that already have a final row do not count.
BH-6382: no new PR is started after the tick has run this many seconds. The rest are logged as deferred. A */30 tick must end before the next one.
